name: The Chase Park Plaza Royal Sonesta St. Louis
positioning: Historic 1922 hotel in St. Louis' Central West End, officially The Royal Sonesta Chase Park Plaza St. Louis, with its own movie theater and a Mediterranean-style pool
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base near Forest Park and the Central West End
Movie lovers who like having a cinema inside the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of St. Louis' Central West End district, with art, boutiques and entertainment nearby.
The hotel is less than two miles from Forest Park.
The Chase was built in 1922 in the Italian Renaissance style.
In 1929, the 27-story Art Deco Park Plaza hotel was built next door.
The hotel has been inducted into Historic Hotels of America.
Rooms and suites have custom hardwood finishes and fine furnishings.
The Park Plaza Executive Apartment has a private elevator entrance and a fully equipped kitchen.
The pool area has a dining terrace, shaded seating and an outdoor fireplace.
The fitness center covers 18,000 square feet.
The hotel has three on-site restaurants.
The Tenderloin Room steakhouse has been a St. Louis institution since the 1960s.
The Khorassan Ballroom is a historic Art Deco ballroom.

highlights.text: A historic five-screen movie theater sits off the main lobby, with stadium seating and a theater bar.
The Mediterranean-style pool is surrounded by fountains and stone-carved porticoes.
The outdoor swimming pool was built in 1954 to host the Miss America Pageant in 1956.
Elvis Presley stayed at The Chase in 1958.
The Chase King room is reached by a private keyed elevator.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is open seasonally.
The hotel charges a nightly destination fee.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may show its age in some areas.
